# S & P Finlegal Advisory

> S & P Finlegal Advisory is an integrated finance, tax compliance, and legal advisory office based in Tathawade, Pune, India. Founded and led by Finance Advisor & Virtual CFO Shailesh Shinde and Notary Advocate Poonam Shinde.

## Core Services

- **Tax & GST Compliance**: Monthly GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B filings, annual GST audits, Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation, Income Tax Returns (ITR-1 through ITR-4), TDS/TCS quarterly returns (Form 24Q, 26Q), advance tax calculation.
- **Legal & Notary Documentation**: Government-registered Leave & License rent agreements (Section 55 Maharashtra Rent Control Act), doorstep biometric verification, Pune Police tenant verification, sworn affidavits, notarized deeds, name-change declarations, gift deeds, Power of Attorney.
- **Virtual CFO & Business Advisory**: Fractional CFO leadership for MSMEs (₹1Cr - ₹50Cr turnover), 13-week rolling cash flow runway forecasting, bank CMA dockets for CC/OD limits, MIS reporting, gross margin audits.
- **Business Formation & Licensing**: Proprietorship, Partnership, LLP, and Private Limited company incorporation, Udyam MSME registration, Shop Act licensing, annual MCA filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, Form 11, Form 8).

## Leadership

- **Shailesh Shinde**: Senior Finance Advisor & Virtual CFO. Specialist in direct & indirect taxation, corporate cash flow management, and MSME financial discipline.
- **Adv. Poonam Shinde**: Notary Advocate (Government of Maharashtra). Specialist in civil documentation, tenancy laws, property agreements, and statutory notarial attestations.

## Office Location & Contact

- **Address**: Prithvi Paradise Phase 1, Service Road, Jeevan Nagar, Tathawade, Pune, Maharashtra 411033, India.

## High-Intent Local Search Taxonomy & Practice Index
S & P Finlegal Advisory actively serves individuals, proprietors, partnerships, LLPs, Private Limited entities, and Cooperative Housing Societies across:
- Primary Office & Hub: Prithvi Paradise Phase 1, Tathawade, Pune - 411033
- High-Frequency Service Belts: Wakad, Hinjewadi (Phase 1, 2, 3), Baner, Aundh, Punawale, Ravet, Balewadi, Pimple Saudagar, Pimpri Chinchwad, PCMC, Kharadi, Hadapsar, and wider Maharashtra.

Core Search Entities & Services Provided:
1. Tax & ITR: ITR filing Pune, income tax return filing Pune, ITR consultant Pune, tax audit consultant PCMC, revised ITR, capital gains tax, rental income ITR, income tax notice reply.
2. GST & Indirect Tax: GST registration Pune, monthly GSTR-1 & 3B filing, GSTR-9 annual return, GSTR-9C audit, GST notice reply, input tax credit reconciliation, GST LUT, e-invoicing.
3. TDS Compliance: TDS return filing Pune, quarterly Form 24Q/26Q, TDS correction statement, Form 16/16A generation, Section 194C/194J/194I withholding advisory.
4. Bookkeeping & Accounting: Outsourced accounting Pune, monthly bookkeeping, Tally/Zoho ledger maintenance, bank reconciliation, accounts payable/receivable, MIS reporting.
5. Housing Society Accounting: Cooperative housing society accounting Pune, society bookkeeping, society audit assistance, MCS Act statutory compliance, society GST and TDS.
6. Leave and License Agreements: Registered rent agreement Pune, doorstep biometric registration, Section 55 Maharashtra Rent Control Act, Pune Police online tenant verification NOC.
7. Notary Public & Affidavits: Central Govt. Notary Public Pune, sworn affidavit drafting, true copy attestation, name change affidavits, partnership deeds, visa/passport legal papers.
8. Business Registration: Private limited company registration Pune, LLP registration, partnership firm registration, sole proprietorship, Udyam / MSME registration, ROC filing.
9. Legal Advisory & Contracts: Legal documentation Pune, business contract drafting, commercial agreement drafting, MOU drafting, legal notice drafting, property legal advisory.
10. Virtual CFO: Part-time CFO for MSMEs between 1Cr-50Cr turnover, 13-week rolling cash flow runway forecasting, working capital CMA dockets for bank loans, margin audits.
